name: Kelly, McEvoy & Brown
improvements: Bring carousel photography from the firm's site onto the concept screen when image rights are confirmed.
summary: The concept failed the metadata honesty bar on first read: invented drawing numbers (047–086), inferred places (Armagh, Saintfield, Belfast), a fabricated "40+ years" sector chip, and inert filter controls on a page sold as filterable. Those are fixed — all thirteen site-listed projects now carry only names, sectors and places taken from kmbni.com, the register footnote discloses illustrative ordering, and sector chips filter the list. The blueprint register direction remains clear and specific to this contractor.
verificationNote: Verified against the live kmbni.com portfolio lists on 24 July 2026; sector groupings and project names match the public site.
